# ADR template

```text
# ADR-NN — Decision title
Status: proposed | accepted by named authority | superseded
Date / author / reviewer:
Source FR/D/HLD IDs and current task:
Context / meaningful problem:
Options and trade-offs (compatibility, licenses, complexity, accessibility):
Decision and explicit scope:
Evidence versus remaining proof gates:
Consequences / risks / rollback or replacement boundary:
Owning contract, acceptance and consumer changes:
Supersedes / superseded by:
Review disposition (never invented by author):
```
